scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Saving In Consumption Of Energy And Water
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Should be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Projects must be implemented and commenced during the scheme’s operation period
Certificate from Energy/Water auditors regarding installation of equipment must be submitted as per audit report
benefits_summary: Up to ₹1,00,000 for 75% of the energy/water audit cost and up to ₹20,00,000 for 25% of equipment cost (one‑time assistance).
documents_required: Certificate from Energy/Water auditors regarding installation of equipment
